# Nano-Tumor Database (NTD 2023) -- derived tables

Generated by `scripts/adapt_ntd.py` from the Nano-Tumor Database, 2023 version
(Chen et al. 2023, *ACS Nano* 17(20):19810-19831, doi:10.1021/acsnano.3c04037;
data mirror: https://github.com/UFPBPK/Nano-Tumor-Database-Version2023), in a
tidy long format (12,590 rows = 534 in-vivo mouse datasets x tissue x time).
The raw file is not committed; put it in `data/external/ntd/raw/` (git-ignored)
and run:

    python scripts/adapt_ntd.py --input data/external/ntd/raw/<file>.csv --fdm-demo

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `ntd_pk_fits.csv` | Per dataset: blood/plasma/serum mono-exponential fit, `k_el_per_hr` (0-72 h window and all times), R^2, `pk_fit_ok` flag, NP metadata |
| `ntd_biopinn_scenarios.csv` | The 152 in-scope datasets (IV, spherical, 10-200 nm, good PK fit) as BIOPINN-ready `(d_NP_nm, k_el_per_hr, t_max_hr)` rows |
| `ntd_tumor_delivery.csv` | Per dataset tumour uptake: Cmax / Tmax / AUC / %ID at 24-48-72 h |
| `ntd_size_bins_summary.csv` | Weak external check: tumour uptake and k_el medians per 10-50 / 50-100 / 100-150 / 150-200 nm bin |
| `ntd_summary.json` | Headline numbers (k_el percentiles, correlations, QC counts) |
| `k_el_config_suggestion.yaml` | The config values these fits imply (applied in `configs/`) |
| `fdm_kel_demo.csv` | FDM at R=400 um, d_NP=100 nm, C0=10 uM, k_d=0.01/hr: k_el = 0 vs NTD median vs p95 |

`%ID` is percent of injected dose per whole organ -- it is *not* a local
concentration and has no radial coordinate, so none of this is used as PINN
training labels. See `docs/NTD_ADAPTATION.md`.
